description:
Facing a forced marriage that feels like being sold off, Eun-seol reaches out to her only lifeline. To Yoon Jung-hyuk, a man who was her homeroom teacher a few years ago and was previously discussing marriage with her cousin. Even if there comes a moment when her heart aches from his cold words, Even if a ending awaits where she is ignored and eventually divorced, She would do anything if it meant escaping this hell. But perhaps this man, this marriage, and this husband's role... he might actually be sincere. Sometimes enough to make Eun-seol hesitate. Before they know it, their feelings for each other slowly seep in, take root, and bloom.
Source: MU
